sources.excerpt: Tsar Bomba — Union Tube Transistor Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Union Tube Transistor is based in East Vancouver, BC Canada. We strive for best practices in our building of musical equipment, pursuing ease of use in durable, repairable products. Our pursuit of great tone is its own reward. ← Back to Shop Tsar Bomba Tsar Bomba from $190.00 The Tsar Bomba is a Muff style circuit which is both 15dB quieter than a standard Muff and 5dB louder. One complaint occasionally heard with Muffs is that they can sound great on their own but get lost when played in a band. The Tsar Bomba employs an original design tone circuit which allows for very precise sculpting to help you carve out your place in a mix. A classic topology updated with modern enhancements, Tsar Bomba is perfect for dialing in wooly Muff-style tones galore. On the volume control, Tsar Bomba gives you a flexible range that extends 15dB below standard designs and 5dB above, ensuring you have enough gain on tap to boost overhead or sit back in the mix. The tone control circuit has been carefully designed from scratch to provide precise sculpting, letting you create tones that cut through full ensemble settings where most muffs would be buried. If you love the classic sound of muff-style fuzz but are looking for something with a little more punch, Tsar Bomba from Union Tube Transistor is ready to rock. Draw is 12mA. Deluxe version has a wooden box, bandana, and laser engraved badge. Bean Counter version has a silkscreened graphic made to look like the badge, and no special packaging. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Union Tube Transistor Tsar Bomba Back to results Union Tube Transistor Tsar Bomba Fuzz Refined Big Muff-style fuzz with extended volume range and precision tone circuit for cutting through full band mixes. Named after the most powerful nuclear weapon ever detonated, the Tsar Bomba is Union Tube Transistor's take on the Big Muff topology—but with critical refinements that address the classic circuit's weaknesses. The volume control offers a flexible range extending 15dB below standard Muff designs and 5dB above, giving you unprecedented control over output level. More importantly, Union designed the tone circuit from scratch to provide precise sculpting capabilities, letting you create tones that cut through full ensemble settings where most Muffs would be buried. This is a Muff for players who love the wooly sustain of the classic circuit but need it to work in a band context. The Tsar Bomba delivers all the harmonic richness of its inspiration while remaining audible in the mix. Demo Videos Specifications Power 9V DC Current Draw ~50mA est.
